PLAN "Prenatal Strength: 12 Weeks Advanced"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength safely during pregnancy"
  GOAL secondary nutrition:
    name "Support pregnancy and lean mass maintenance"
  GOAL secondary cardio:
    name "Support cardiovascular health during pregnancy"
  GOAL secondary core:
    name "Maintain core strength and function during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1-4:
      DAY Monday "Lower Body Strength":
        focus: "Squat, posterior chain, single leg, calves"
      DAY Tuesday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Walking, low-moderate intensity"
      DAY Wednesday "Upper Body Push & Core":
        focus: "Shoulder press, incline press, bench press, triceps, delts, bird dog, dead bug"
      DAY Thursday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Cycling, low-moderate intensity"
      DAY Friday "Upper Body Pull & Core":
        focus: "Lat pulldown, dumbbell row, face pull, pallof press, side plank"
  PHASE "Phase 2: Progression & Intensity" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5-8:
      DAY Monday "Lower Body & Glutes":
        focus: "Squat, hip thrust, step up, calves, bird dog, dead bug"
      DAY Tuesday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Walking, moderate intensity"
      DAY Wednesday "Upper Body Push & Core":
        focus: "Shoulder press, incline press, bench press, triceps, front raise, pallof press, side plank"
      DAY Thursday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Cycling, moderate intensity"
      DAY Friday "Upper Body Pull & Core":
        focus: "Lat pulldown, barbell row, face pull, bird dog, dead bug"
  PHASE "Phase 3: Maintenance & Peak" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9-11:
      DAY Monday "Lower Body & Mobility":
        focus: "Goblet squat, hip thrust, step up, calves, bird dog, dead bug"
      DAY Tuesday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Walking, low-moderate intensity"
      DAY Wednesday "Upper Body Push & Core":
        focus: "Shoulder press, incline press, bench press, triceps, lateral raise, pallof press, side plank"
      DAY Thursday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Cycling, low-moderate intensity"
      DAY Friday "Upper Body Pull & Core":
        focus: "Lat pulldown, dumbbell row, face pull, bird dog, dead bug"
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday "Lower Body Peak":
        focus: "Goblet squat, hip thrust, step up, calves, bird dog, dead bug (submaximal sets, RPE 8)"
      DAY Tuesday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Walking, low-moderate intensity"
      DAY Wednesday "Upper Body Push Peak":
        focus: "Shoulder press, incline press, bench press, triceps, lateral raise, pallof press, side plank (submaximal sets, RPE 8)"
      DAY Thursday "Prenatal Cardio":
        focus: "Cycling, low-moderate intensity"
      DAY Friday "Upper Body Pull Peak":
        focus: "Lat pulldown, dumbbell row, face pull, bird dog, dead bug (submaximal sets, RPE 8)"

NUTRITION
  STRATEGY "Pregnancy Lean Mass Maintenance":
    calories: "Slight surplus (OB-guided, typically +300 kcal/day in 2nd trimester, +400 kcal/day in 3rd trimester)"
    protein: "1.6-2.0g per kg bodyweight daily"
    carbohydrates: "Emphasize complex carbs, whole grains, fruits, vegetables"
    fats: "Include healthy fats (avocado, olive oil, nuts, seeds, fatty fish)"
    hydration: "Minimum 2.5-3L water daily"
    micronutrients:
      folate: "Prioritize folate-rich foods and prenatal supplement"
      iron: "Include iron-rich foods (lean red meat, beans, spinach); pair with vitamin C"
      calcium: "Dairy, fortified plant milks, leafy greens"
      vitamin_d: "Supplement as needed per OB guidance"
      omega_3: "Fatty fish or supplement (DHA/EPA)"
    meal_timing: "3-5 balanced meals/snacks per day, avoid fasting"
    food_safety: "Avoid raw/undercooked meats, unpasteurized dairy, high-mercury fish"
    notes: "Consult with OB or registered dietitian for individual adjustments and supplement needs"
